use_cases: Displaying image or media galleries with smooth drag-to-navigate functionality
Creating product showcases in e-commerce with controlled or uncontrolled index state
Building feature carousels for SaaS landing pages with customizable navigation
Implementing testimonial sliders with drag support and arrow navigation
Displaying content collections with context-based state management
ai_summary: A motion-primitives carousel component with drag-to-navigate functionality and smooth animations via motion/react. Features a Provider pattern for context-based state management, supports both controlled and uncontrolled modes, and includes navigation arrows. Fully responsive and composable with customizable drag behavior and index change callbacks.
